execution.reason: All tasks share a focused contract test and build sequentially from tests to policy to lifecycle integration.

tasks.title: Lock Research-Enforcement Contracts
tasks.description: Focused tests express classification, evidence, citation, privacy, correction, and Fabric integration contracts and demonstrate the intended red state against the absent extension.
acceptance_criteria: Tests cover none, standard, high, and explicit opt-out classification.
Tests cover provider independence, exact direct and Fabric mappings for opt-in xAI web search, citation shape, privacy, and one-correction behavior.
The initial focused run fails for the intended missing policy or extension behavior rather than a malformed test.

tasks.title: Implement Pure Research Policy
tasks.description: A dependency-free policy and trusted configuration satisfy tier classification, evidence normalization, Fabric trace, citation, privacy, and configuration tests without requiring a Pi runtime.
acceptance_criteria: Pure policy tests pass without loading a Pi runtime.
Only successful independent provider categories satisfy evidence requirements.
Direct xai_grok_web_search and exact Fabric ref extensions.xai_grok_web_search map to one independent xai-web-search category only after successful use.
Configuration and metrics logic fail safely and retain metadata only.

tasks.title: Wire Corrective Extension Lifecycle
tasks.description: The lifecycle integration injects routes, observes direct and Fabric-mediated research, reports status and metadata-only metrics, and performs at most one race-safe corrective turn.
acceptance_criteria: Main uses trusted project discovery and child scope follows existing load or exclusion controls.
Direct and Fabric-mediated successful research activity, including explicit successful xAI web search, updates per-turn provider metadata.
The extension never enables or invokes the opt-in xAI web-search tool automatically.
A correction marker is persisted before dispatch and no turn receives a second correction.
Status and metrics commands expose policy metadata without raw research content.

tasks.title: Verify Integrated Research Enforcement
tasks.description: The complete feature passes focused checks and graph validation without introducing regressions, restoring deleted extensions, or modifying unrelated runtime state.
acceptance_criteria: Focused tests, including xAI direct/Fabric mapping and no-auto-activation safeguards, and TypeScript syntax checks pass.
The active task graph and every retained artifact graph validate.
The full suite has no new failures beyond the two documented unrelated baseline failures, if those remain.
Legacy deleted extensions remain absent and unrelated runtime state is untouched.
verification: for f in .pi/artifacts/*/tasks.json; do node --experimental-strip-types .pi/scripts/task-graph.ts validate "$f"; done
